thought.text: `sendEmail` runs synchronously in the backend. First attempt hit DNS (now fixed); second hit the cooldown. Let me clear the OTP row and re-trigger to get a fresh email through the relay.

reasoning_content:
`sendEmail` is called directly from the backend (not from a worker). The first attempt failed with ENOTFOUND (DNS issue, now fixed). The second attempt hit the cooldown and no email was sent. Let's wait for the cooldown to expire (or just trigger a fresh attempt). The cooldown is EMAIL_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN. Let me check the duration. The OTP was created at 22:35:44. Let me check the cooldown constant.

Actually, a simpler approach: delete the OTP row to clear the cooldown, then re-trigger. Or wait. Let me check the value of the cooldown.

action.command: grep -rn "EMAIL_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN" /workspace/backend/workspaces/core-backend/src/constants/*.ts | head -2; docker exec workspace-postgres-1 psql -U daz -d daz -c "DELETE FROM email_otps;" && docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/auth/init-email-login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"client":"dashboard","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","schoolSlug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"
